name: optimizedhtml-start-template
description: OptimizedHTML is all-inclusive, optimized for Google PageSpeed start HTML5 template with Bootstrap (grid only), Gulp, Sass, Browsersync, Autoprefixer, PostCSS, Uglify, gulp-imagemin, Vinyl-FTP (+Rsync) and Bower (libs path) support. The template contains a .htaccess file with caching rules for web server.
